title: Nasodoro, Goldfinger, Chrysostomos, Maindorée, Silversmile, Silberselber Vifargent, Panargros
html_source:
Nasodoro: (Ital.) Golden-nosed
Chrysostomos: (Greek) Gold-mouthed
Maindoree: (Fr.) Gold-handed
Silberselber: (Ger.) Silver-self/body
Vifargent: (Lat.) Life-silver; quicksilver
Panargos: (Greek) All-silver
